subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I walked out ________ I wanted to breathe some fresh air.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Because__ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The meaning of the word **"because'' **is *for the reason that.*
 
• Because is a **subordinating conjunction** which is used to *connect two sentences or to join subordinate clauses with independent clauses*.
 
• In the above sentence, the words prior to the blank are trying to explain that **"I walked out **, while the words after the blank are '**giving the reason why I walked out of the room.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"But"** is a conjunction which is *used to introduce a concept that differs or contrasts with what has just been expressed.*
 
• **"That" **is a determiner , pronoun , conjunction , adverb which is *used to relate to a subject, specifically when the subject is distant from the speaker.*
 
• **"Yet"** is an adverb, conjunction which is used* with negative verbs or in questions to discuss an event that has not yet occurred but that you anticipate will occur*
